description: This file implements the SoC_GstPlayer class, which appears to be a singleton managing a GStreamer-based media player for Miracast streaming. It includes methods for lifecycle management (launch, stop, pause, resume), setting video display rectangle, handling the first video frame callback, and notifying playback state.

classes.name: SoC_GstPlayer
classes.description: Singleton class managing GStreamer playback for Miracast streaming, including lifecycle control, video rectangle configuration, and playback state notifications.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SoC_GstPlayer, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance of SoC_GstPlayer if it exists.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle parameters.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Initializes and starts the player with the given local IP, streaming port, and RTSP instance.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and destructs the player instance.

methods.name: onFirstVideoFrameCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the first video frame is received, updating state and notifying RTSP.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notifies RTSP handler of current playback state.
